cropGuidance: Supply real app captures or stills. Portrait 9:16 is preferred. Keep the primary UI in the central 70% of frame, avoid tiny text, and leave the top 12% and bottom 18% clear for overlays and platform controls. The compositor fits the complete source frame inside the portrait canvas and pads unused space; it does not crop or pan captures. Do not draw, recreate, or alter app UI or values.
